# Tesseract.js OCR Assets

This directory vendors the local browser OCR dependency used by the Visitor Reception Console ID Capture workflow.

- Source package: `tesseract.js@5.1.1`
- Core package: `tesseract.js-core@5.1.1`
- Language data: `@tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0`
- Runtime use: browser-side OCR only; visitor ID images are not uploaded to an external OCR service.
- License: see `LICENSE.tesseract-js.md`.
